The graph gives the estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre, for a farm when the amount of fertilizer applied is
[Figure 2]
pounds per acre. What does the
[Figure 3]
-value of the vertex of the graph represent in this context?

choices.A: The amount of fertilizer, in pounds per acre, applied to the farm
choices.B: The estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre, when no fertilizer is applied
choices.C: The maximum estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre
choices.D: The minimum estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre

explanation: Choice C is correct. The graph shows the estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre, when the amount of fertilizer applied is $x$ pounds per acre, where the crop yield is represented by the $y$-value. The graph shows a downward-opening parabola with its vertex at approximately $(15, 180)$. Since the parabola opens downward, the vertex represents the maximum point of the function. Therefore, the $y$-value of the vertex, which is approximately $180$, represents the maximum estimated crop yield, in bushels per acre.
